evals.name: full-metrics-plan-b2b
evals.prompt: We're launching a new paid analytics tier for our B2B SaaS. Launch is 6 weeks away. Can you build us a full launch metrics plan?
evals.expected_output: Response walks through 3 Steps to Metrics Success: stakeholder success statements (at least 4 stakeholders), 5-7 metrics with numeric targets, windows, sources, and baselines, dashboard plan, reporting cadence (day 7, 30, 60, 90), and risks. No vanity metrics; each metric has a number.

assertions.text: Response produces success statements for at least 4 stakeholders (CEO, CMO, CRO, CPO, CS)
Metric set is 5-7 metrics, not 3 or 15
Every metric has a specific numeric target, not a verb
Every metric has a measurement window (day 7, 30, 60, 90, etc.)
Every metric has a source named (CRM, Amplitude, etc.)
Response includes baseline for each metric where available
Reporting cadence covers day 7, 30, 60, 90 at minimum
Risks or pitfalls section is present

evals.name: day-30-report-miss
evals.prompt: Our launch missed the signup goal badly (95 paid signups in 30 days versus pacing for 500 in 90 days). Press and adoption are ahead. Write the day 30 report.
evals.expected_output: Honest report using the day 30 template. Leads with the real read: behind on ARR/signups, ahead on press/adoption. Results table with target vs actual. What worked and what didn't, with specific causes. What we're changing, with concrete actions. Customer quotes. Thanks. Next checkpoint. Does not spin the miss.

assertions.text: Headline leads with the real read, not spin
Results table has target, actual, on-track per metric
Both 'what worked' and 'what didn't' sections are present
Causes for the miss are specific (e.g., deal cycle length, channel CPA), not vague
Report does not frame the miss as 'early momentum' or other spin

evals.name: vanity-metric-pushback
evals.prompt: Our CMO wants to use 'impressions' and 'total reach' as the primary launch metrics. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: Pushback on vanity metrics. Explains why impressions and reach are weak without downstream action. Suggests tying awareness goals to specific outcomes: direct traffic to launch page, branded search lift, press mentions in target pubs, MQL volume. Recommends pairing awareness with conversion metrics.

assertions.text: Response pushes back on impressions/reach as primary metrics
Explains why: they don't tie to downstream action
Suggests specific alternatives: direct traffic, branded search, tier-1 press mentions, MQLs
Recommends pairing awareness with conversion metrics
